sections.section_title: GFXTIM absolute frame counter compare 1 register (GFXTIM_AFCC1R)
sections.text_helper: Section 23.5.17 "GFXTIM absolute frame counter compare 1 register (GFXTIM_AFCC1R)" in chapter 23 (Graphic timer (GFXTIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1111.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:0 FRAME[19:0]: Frame number
Compare 1 value for the absolute frame counter.
